description: Closed registry of target-admission generators and the construct->graph vocabulary for economic_propagation.propagation_hypothesis/v1. A generator names ONE way a target can be admitted into a propagation hypothesis, tagged with the graph its evidence actually belongs to. Rows with admits_target=false are REFUSALS: their construct exists (so it can be recorded as Graph-3 context) but it can never be the reason a target is considered economic propagation. This registry is a vocabulary, not a graph, a store, or a control plane. K3-D reads owner artifacts; it never writes them.

binding_kills.DNR:KILL-PSS-SR2-PEER-DIFFUSION: Peer new-low diffusion at a tested low: exact construction closed; stratified effects adverse on every outcome layer (DEV and VAL). Peer adjacency does not mean transfer.
binding_kills.DNR:KILL-PSS-SR3-PARTICIPATION: CORRECTED SUMMARY (c0 §4.2 rider repair): SR3 did not merely demote participation to display tier — it KILLED the synchronized peer-participation target-generator construction outright, and requires any future peer-state species to measure an ORTHOGONAL source of durable absorption or selective leadership, never another contemporaneous sector-breadth relief label. In this contract, peer participation/breadth alone can never admit a target (admits_target=false below).
binding_kills.DNR:KILL-CN-SUPPLY-ABSORPTION: Price-only absorption is momentum (construct kill, #1944). Absorption cannot be reconstituted from broad participation or co-movement, in any market.
binding_kills.DNR:KILL-CAUSAL-DAG-ALPHA: No causal DAG -> alpha score -> trade path from discovered graphs. This record class is hypothesis/evidence tier with all authority axes const-false.

construct_owners_note: K3D_R034: a leg or admission whose owner_ref.owner_program is not a lawful owner of its construct is refused — group-reads REFUSES Customer/Supplier/Partner/Competitor labels (engine/group_linked_outsiders.py), so group-reads can never be the owner of a role-specific Graph-1 construct; only its role-unknown agreement construct binds to it.

gmi-theme-graph.note: K3D_R035: theme-graph edge_ids are structured '<type>:<src>-><dst>@<date>'. A Graph-1 leg citing this owner must cite Graph-1-type edge ids; a MEMBER_OF/EXPRESSES id re-labeled as a customer/supplier claim is refused by grammar, not trusted by field value. As of freeze, ZERO Graph-1-type edges have ever been emitted, so any Graph-1 claim on this owner is refusable-by-construction until W4 lands.

construct_notes.disclosed_agreement_role_unknown: A generic 8-K agreement or a financing-agent counterparty proves two names signed something — it does NOT say who supplies whom. Graph-1-candidate only; role must stay role_unknown (K3D_R031). GR linked-outsiders' closed vocabulary and module header forbid Customer/Supplier/Partner/Competitor labels.
construct_notes.ownership_cashflow_change: Ownership counts as Graph 1 only when it changes cash-flow rights (JV, sub, parent). GovRev defense19-v1 legal/ownership identity is NOT an economic relationship by itself.
construct_notes.protocol_comparability: Bio trial-protocol comparability (same indication/endpoint) is not a commercial peer; contract text of trial_peer_set.v1 forbids the inference.
construct_notes.etf_tracking: A tradable proxy, not economic exposure; exposure axes stay reserved-null.
construct_notes.theme_membership: Theme/basket membership is vocabulary (Graph 2). It is never a supplier or beneficiary edge; theme_graph reserved Graph-1 edge types have never been emitted (zero rows on main at freeze time).
construct_notes.historical_transmission_neighbor: Neighbor is not cause. Admits a target for study only; asserts no economic path.

generators.refusal: REFUSAL ROW (binding, c0 §4.2): peer participation/breadth alone can never admit a target as economic propagation. DNR:KILL-PSS-SR2-PEER-DIFFUSION and DNR:KILL-PSS-SR3-PARTICIPATION killed the participation/diffusion target-generator constructions; SR3 additionally requires any future peer-state species to measure an orthogonal source. Participation may appear as a market_evidence leg (Graph-3 context) on a target admitted by another generator; it may never appear in generator_admissions.
